title: God of War Laufey delayed to May 20, 2027 ⏳
subject: godofwar
description:
Does a three-month wait change your plans? 👇

Santa Monica Studio announced on November 4, 2026 that God of War Laufey is delayed from February 16 to May 20, 2027 on PS5, saying the game needs more work. Faye, Kratos's late wife and Atreus's mother, is the first mainline God of War lead who isn't Kratos.

Sources: Santa Monica Studio on X (Nov 4, 2026), VGC (Nov 4, 2026), Game Informer (Nov 4, 2026), Wccftech (Nov 4, 2026)
Game images © Sony Interactive Entertainment.
tags: god of war laufey release date

scenes.text: God of War Laufey just slipped by three months.
Santa Monica Studio posted on X on November 4: the PS5 game moves from February 16 to May 20, 2027.
The studio's reason is short: the game needs more work before it ships.
Sony revealed Laufey at a State of Play on June 2, and pre-orders opened September 29.
It's the first mainline God of War led by someone other than Kratos, his late wife Faye.
Pre-order holders now have a new date, May 20, 2027.
